scenario: The ego car executes a left turn at an intersection from the right lane while an adversarial car proceeds straight through the intersection from the left lane.

ego.behavior: The car turns left at the intersection from the right lane.

adversarials.behavior: The car proceeds straight ahead through the intersection from the left lane.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane road approaching an intersection, the ego vehicle starts in the right lane and an adversarial car starts in the left lane, with both traveling parallel toward the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must spawn a set distance from the intersection in the right lane, and the adversarial car must spawn a set distance from the intersection in the left lane; the scenario terminates once both vehicles have cleared the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the turning car from first-person perspective; the straight-moving car is the adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initial both approach intersection in parallel lanes; midpoint ego initiates left turn while adversarial continues straight; ending both clear intersection. 4. Evidence: ego trajectory arcs left across lanes while adversarial maintains constant forward vector.
